name: William
mentions: William is mourning in sackcloth and ashes for the loss of all but one of his carrier pigeons. It is to be hoped that they will return, as they bid fair to afford ready and swif…

"Do you want a horoscope, I don't know."  The above was addressed to William, he of cold turkey fame. William, seated behind his dry-goods counter and being in the midst of a calculation as to how many cold turkeys at steen bits a piece it would…
